final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) AS group_avg FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) AS baseline_avg FROM group_averages) SELECT AVG(g.group_avg) AS mean_above_baseline, AVG(g.group_avg - b.baseline_avg) AS mean_excess FROM group_averages AS g CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE g.group_avg > b.baseline_avg
